item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"C1","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Use `dspy.LM(..., model_type=\"responses\")` and patch or mock `litellm.responses` so the program captures the exact outbound provider request DSPy sends in responses mode.","span_ids":["E1","E2"]},{"claim_id":"C2","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"Pass `messages=` as a multi-turn list that includes a user turn whose `content` is a list containing both a text item and an `image_url` item, so the multimodal conversion path is exercised.","span_ids":["E3","E4"]},{"claim_id":"C3","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"Inspect the mocked provider call's `input` keyword argument and print or assert against that exact structure, rather than relying only on the returned completion text.","span_ids":["E2","E3"]},{"claim_id":"C4","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"Assert that the emitted responses payload contains exactly one `input` item and that this item's `role` is the role of the last original message (for the sample conversation, `user`), proving DSPy flattened the turns instead of preserving separate entries.","span_ids":["E3"]},{"claim_id":"C5","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"Assert that all textual content appears in order as `input_text` blocks inside the flattened `content` list, including both plain-string message bodies and `{\"type\": \"text\"}` multimodal items.","span_ids":["E3","E4"]},{"claim_id":"C6","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"Assert that the image content is preserved as a single `input_image` block whose `image_url` value is the original nested URL string.","span_ids":["E4"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"E1","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":177,"end_line":189},{"span_id":"E2","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":479,"end_line":492},{"span_id":"E3","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":518,"end_line":528},{"span_id":"E4","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":565,"end_line":575}]}
